FN-AZULQ7-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 2
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Jim Carns
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 07/17/2023
House Bill 2 as introduced would increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid
from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30,
2024.
Page 1
